title: An idempotent of a local ring is 0 or 1
statement:
Let $R$ be a local ring (a commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$; in particular $0
eq1$ in $R$) and $e\in R$ an idempotent, $e^2=e$. Then $e=0$ or $e=1$. Consequently, for an idempotent $e$ of $R$ the conditions $e
eq0$, $e=1$ and $e
otin\mathfrak m$ ($e$ a unit) are equivalent.
